proposed.text: Under SPP 201, what does Architectural Programming incorporate as part of the problem-seeking process?

options.text: A schematic design concept for immediate construction documentation
A project feasibility report based on primary data
A space program with characterizations of the envisioned spaces
A design brief for bidding out architectural services

proposed.code_citation: UAP SPP Document 201, Architectural Programming, PDF p.48.

rationale.a: Schematic design belongs to later design work, not the SPP 201 source wording for Architectural Programming.
rationale.b: A feasibility report is a different pre-design service.
rationale.c: Correct. The SPP 201 raw PDF says Architectural Programming incorporates a space program with characterizations of the envisioned spaces.
rationale.d: A design brief is a separate SPP 201 service.
rationale.correct: SPP 201 describes Architectural Programming as an analytical problem-seeking process that identifies horizontal and vertical requirements and incorporates a space program.
rationale.takeaway: Architectural Programming in SPP 201 points to requirements plus a space program, not schematic design.
